sentences.text: FDA's records show etoposide is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 73 vials of etoposide 20 mg/mL, 25 mL at 3 vials per day, providing 24.3 days on hand.
No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our current stock.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from AVYXA Pharma, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
AVYXA Pharma's label does not name a plant we could place.
Secondary options include Accord Healthcare Inc. and BluePoint Laboratories, neither of which is on FDA's shortage list today.
